kind.description: What it is. One of: `file`: A file in the workspace.; `patch`: A patch.; `report`: A report, meant to be read.

path.description: Where it is. The contract asks for a path relative to the workspace; #130's session wrote absolute ones, so both are accepted and the driver rewrites neither.

assumptions.description: What the session decided alone, because it could not ask.

status.description: The session's own verdict on the task. One of: `ok`: The task was done.; `partial`: The session stopped short on its own and says what is left.; `failed`: The task could not be done; `error` says why.; `cancelled`: A later instruction told the session to wind down.
